title: ExtorQ - macOS Investigation
description: macOS hosts (asset_type macos_host): launch items, listening sockets, local and sudo authentication failures, installed applications with their code signature and the host's services. Sources: macos.launchd, macos.inventory, macos.unified_log (native macOS collector). host = the name inside the asset id. Text fields are telemetry.

panels.title: Launch item changes
panels.description: LaunchAgent / LaunchDaemon plists created, modified or deleted, newest first (MAC-001 inputs; MAC-002 looks at the program: a shell, interpreter or user-writable path). Source: macos.launchd. Plist contents beyond these fields are not collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, replaceRegexpOne(asset_id, '^[a-z0-9]+:', '') AS host, event_type, resource_path AS plist,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'label') AS label,
       if(JSONType(attributes, 'program') = 'String', JSONExtractString(attributes, 'program'),
          JSONExtractRaw(attributes, 'program')) AS program,
       multiIf(JSONType(attributes, 'run_at_load') != 'Bool', 'unknown', JSONExtractBool(attributes, 'run_at_load'), 'yes', 'no') AS run_at_load,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'scope') AS scope,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'sha256') AS sha256
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND asset_type = 'macos_host'
  AND event_type IN ('persistence.launchd.item_created', 'persistence.launchd.item_modified', 'persistence.launchd.item_deleted')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Launch item changes by type
panels.description: Distinct launch item changes per interval. Source: macos.launchd.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, event_type, uniqExact(event_id) AS events
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND asset_type = 'macos_host'
  AND event_type IN ('persistence.launchd.item_created', 'persistence.launchd.item_modified', 'persistence.launchd.item_deleted')
GROUP BY time, event_type
ORDER BY time, event_type

panels.title: Listening sockets opened and closed
panels.description: Listening sockets that appeared or disappeared between inventory snapshots, with the owning process (MAC-003 inputs: all-interface listeners of processes that are not allow-listed). Source: macos.inventory. A listener shorter than one snapshot interval can be missed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, replaceRegexpOne(asset_id, '^[a-z0-9]+:', '') AS host, event_type, process_name AS process,
       net_protocol AS protocol, dst_ip AS address, dst_port AS port,
       multiIf(dst_ip IS NULL, 'unknown',
               dst_ip IN ('127.0.0.1', '::1'), 'loopback',
               dst_ip IN ('0.0.0.0', '::', '*'), 'all interfaces',
               'specific address') AS exposure
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND asset_type = 'macos_host'
  AND event_type IN ('network.listener.opened', 'network.listener.closed')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Authentication failures by type
panels.description: sudo denials, local authentication failures (authd / opendirectoryd) and SSH failures per interval (MAC-004 inputs). Source: macos.unified_log. SSH events exist only when Remote Login is enabled.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, event_type, uniqExact(event_id) AS failures
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND asset_type = 'macos_host'
  AND event_type IN ('auth.sudo.failure', 'auth.local.failure', 'auth.ssh.login_failed', 'auth.ssh.invalid_user', 'auth.ssh.preauth_closed', 'auth.ssh.max_auth_exceeded')
GROUP BY time, event_type
ORDER BY time, event_type

panels.title: Recent authentication failures
panels.description: Authentication failures, newest first, with the user and the reason macOS logged. Source: macos.unified_log. Passwords are never logged or collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, replaceRegexpOne(asset_id, '^[a-z0-9]+:', '') AS host, event_type, actor_name AS user,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'reason') AS reason,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'subsystem') AS subsystem, src_ip
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND asset_type = 'macos_host'
  AND event_type IN ('auth.sudo.failure', 'auth.local.failure', 'auth.ssh.login_failed', 'auth.ssh.invalid_user', 'auth.ssh.preauth_closed', 'auth.ssh.max_auth_exceeded')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Applications installed and removed
panels.description: Application bundles that appeared in or left an inventoried application directory, with the code-signature status when it could be determined (MAC-005 inputs: unsigned applications). Source: macos.inventory. unknown = the signature could not be checked; it is never reported as signed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, replaceRegexpOne(asset_id, '^[a-z0-9]+:', '') AS host, event_type, resource_name AS application,
       resource_path AS path, JSONExtractString(attributes, 'bundle_id') AS bundle_id,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'version') AS version,
       multiIf(JSONType(attributes, 'signed') != 'Bool', 'unknown', JSONExtractBool(attributes, 'signed'), 'signed', 'unsigned') AS signature,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'signature_team_id') AS team_id
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND asset_type = 'macos_host'
  AND event_type IN ('software.installed', 'software.removed')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: macOS services
panels.description: Current state: launchd jobs, processes and listeners discovered on macOS hosts with their adapter and coverage. Source: v_services (macOS service discovery). Coverage: unsupported = no adapter; planned = extension point only, no telemetry; unmonitored = adapter not enabled; degraded = stale/failing (also when the discovery record is older than 1 h); monitored = enabled and fresh. The console/API also checks collector staleness per telemetry source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(asset_id, '^[a-z0-9]+:', '') AS host, name AS service, service_kind AS kind, category, product,
       adapter_id AS adapter, multiIf(adapter_support = 'none', 'unsupported', adapter_support = 'planned', 'planned', monitoring_status = 'unmonitored', 'unmonitored', monitoring_status = 'degraded', 'degraded', last_seen < now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR, 'degraded (stale record)', 'monitored') AS coverage, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(e -> concat(JSONExtractString(e, 'protocol'), '/', toString(JSONExtractUInt(e, 'port')), ' ', JSONExtractString(e, 'exposure'), ' (', JSONExtractString(e, 'attribution'), ')'), JSONExtractArrayRaw(endpoints)), ', ') AS endpoints,
       instance_count, last_seen AS discovery_refreshed, coverage_note
FROM extorq.v_services
WHERE present = 1
  AND asset_id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM extorq.v_assets WHERE asset_type = 'macos_host')
ORDER BY host, coverage, name
LIMIT 500
